scripts.build: cd packages/tui && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build && cd ../agent && npm run build && cd ../coding-agent && npm run build && cd ../mom && npm run build && cd ../pods && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "ai,agent,coding-agent,mom,tui" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow,red,white,magenta" "cd packages/ai && npm run dev" "cd packages/agent && npm run dev" "cd packages/coding-agent && npm run dev" "cd packages/mom && npm run dev" "cd packages/tui && npm run dev"
scripts.check: biome check --error-on-warnings . && tsgo --noEmit && node scripts/check-browser-smoke.mjs && node scripts/check-mouse-smoke.mjs && node scripts/check-architecture-debt.mjs
scripts.version:patch: npm version patch -ws --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && shx rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules package-lock.json && npm install
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor -ws --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && shx rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules package-lock.json && npm install
scripts.version:major: npm version major -ws --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && shx rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules package-lock.json && npm install
scripts.refresh-lockfiles: shx rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules package-lock.json bun.lock && npm install && bun install --frozen-lockfile=false
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run check
scripts.publish: npm run prepublishOnly && npm publish -ws --access public
scripts.publish:dry: npm run prepublishOnly && npm publish -ws --access public --dry-run
scripts.release:quake-cli-checklist: node -e "console.log('Quake-only CLI release checklist'); console.log('1. Finish de-upstreaming blockers before publish: quakecode-agent-core must build without @mariozechner/pi-ai, and quakecode-jiti / quakecode-clipboard must stop depending on @mariozechner/* wrappers.'); console.log('2. Refresh lockfiles: npm run refresh-lockfiles, then confirm bun.lock and package-lock.json no longer contain upstream deps for @mrquake/quakecode-cli.'); console.log('3. Verify manifests/tarballs in dependency order with npm pack --json from each package dir: packages/ai -> packages/agent -> packages/tui -> packages/jiti -> packages/clipboard -> packages/coding-agent. Inspect name, version, files, dependencies, and optionalDependencies before publishing.'); console.log('4. Publish in dependency order only after each package passes pack validation: @mrquake/quakecode-ai, @mrquake/quakecode-agent-core, @mrquake/quakecode-tui, @mrquake/quakecode-jiti, @mrquake/quakecode-clipboard, @mrquake/quakecode-cli.'); console.log('5. After each publish, verify npm registry metadata with npm view <pkg> version dependencies optionalDependencies and stop if any upstream @mariozechner entries remain.'); console.log('6. After CLI publish, check npm dependency pages for @mrquake/quakecode-cli and its direct Quake packages to ensure only Quake-scoped deps appear, then smoke-test install/update from the published tarball or registry package.');"
